related.title: DETR：集合預測與二分配對
related.titleEn: DETR: set prediction and bipartite matching
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付張量欄位契約、座標往返與同格案例。；637與2548一致，展平往返完全相同且座標誤差小於1e−6。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver tensor contracts, coordinate roundtrips and same-cell cases.; Counts match, tensor roundtrip is exact and coordinate error is below1e−6.
related.difference: 畫兩查詢與兩真值的四條邊，標成本；列兩個合法排列及非法重複真值選擇。；兩次最優成本4與5成立，每真值恰配一次，未匹配查詢有明確處理。
related.differenceEn: Draw four query-target edges with costs, both legal permutations and the illegal duplicate-target choice.; Optimal costs4 and5 hold, each target is matched once and unmatched queries are handled explicitly.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 初代網格輸出元素S²(B×5+C)，每框4座標加信心；此公式不通用於後續所有版本。；教學S7,B2,C3；比較S14，類別數為合成設定。；E=7²(2×5+3)=637；S14時2548。
二物件配對比較兩種一對一總成本；逐列貪婪不一定是全域最小。；教學成本矩陣[[1,2],[2,100]]；擾動第一列第二項為3。；交叉配對成本2+2=4，對角101；擾動後交叉3+2=5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Original output size is S²(5B+C), with four coordinates and confidence per box; later versions differ.; Teaching S7,B2,C3, compared with S14; class count is synthetic.; E=7²(2×5+3)=637; S14 gives2548.

Two-object assignment compares both one-to-one total costs; rowwise greedy choice need not be globally optimal.; Teaching cost matrix[[1,2],[2,100]]; perturb its top-right entry to3.; Cross-assignment costs2+2=4 versus diagonal101; after perturbation it costs3+2=5.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Swin Transformer：視窗與位移連接
related.titleEn: Swin Transformer: windows and shifted connectivity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付張量欄位契約、座標往返與同格案例。；637與2548一致，展平往返完全相同且座標誤差小於1e−6。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver tensor contracts, coordinate roundtrips and same-cell cases.; Counts match, tensor roundtrip is exact and coordinate error is below1e−6.
related.difference: 畫8×8個7×7視窗，再平移3格；明列循環平移產生的跨邊界遮罩。；兩成本正確且跨邊界遮罩測試通過；位移前後token數守恆。
related.differenceEn: Draw8×8 windows of7×7 then shift by3; explicitly mark masks for cyclic boundary wraparound.; Both costs match, boundary-mask tests pass and token count is conserved across shifts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 初代網格輸出元素S²(B×5+C)，每框4座標加信心；此公式不通用於後續所有版本。；教學S7,B2,C3；比較S14，類別數為合成設定。；E=7²(2×5+3)=637；S14時2548。
一頭視窗分數元素=(HW/M²)×M⁴=HWM²，假設H,W均可被M整除。；教學特徵56×56，視窗M7；比較M14。；E=56²×49=153664；M14時614656。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Original output size is S²(5B+C), with four coordinates and confidence per box; later versions differ.; Teaching S7,B2,C3, compared with S14; class count is synthetic.; E=7²(2×5+3)=637; S14 gives2548.
Per-head window attention entries equal HWM², assuming divisibility by window width M.; Teaching56×56 feature map, M7 versus M14.; E=56²×49=153664; M14 gives614656.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
